items.question: How safe is Greece?
items.answer: We felt very safe throughout the trip. Athens can look rougher around the edges than some northern European capitals, but that was mostly an aesthetic impression rather than a feeling of danger.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: In the tourist areas we visited, yes. Also, your brain adapts to the Greek alphabet faster than you expect, which makes signs feel much less intimidating after a day or two.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Greece?
items.answer: Expecting ancient Greece to still exist. The ruins are extraordinary precisely because they are fragments of a civilisation inside a living modern country. Also: Santorini crowds. Go a little before or after peak summer if you can.
